Step C Probe results: (1) Translation invariance FAIL — LH/HL/HH shift diff 0.829/1.382/1.331, far above threshold 0.1. Root cause: Haar DWT is NOT translation-invariant (2x2 block grouping changes with shift), and finite-size FFT has boundary effects. The combination DWT+FFT is fundamentally not shift-invariant. This explains training instability and DINO-S drop. (2) LL isolation PASS — LL uses ll_c directly. (3) HH gradient flow PASS — content grad norm=1.0, HH contribution=0.397. (4) Conditional pathway PASS — phase-anchored only modifies target, not model. CONCLUSION: Phase-anchored HF transport failed because the DWT+FFT combination is not translation-invariant, making the FM target unstable across batches. The theoretical motivation (phase cancellation) was correct but the implementation on Haar subbands introduces shift sensitivity that negates the benefit.

BOTTLENECK ANALYSIS after 33 failed directions: (1) DINOv2 CLS is highly sensitive to LL subband stats (color/contrast/global illumination). (2) brk_a AdaIN alpha=0.3 is Pareto optimal — larger alpha breaks content, smaller alpha loses style. (3) All 30 HF directions failed — HF contributes minimally to DINO-S. (4) Weak conditioning (style_gate 0.056-0.061) is symptom not cause. (5) Phase-anchored proved frequency-domain operations are not the answer. CORE CONTRADICTION: AdaIN (diagonal covariance matching) loses channel correlations, limiting style transfer precision at given alpha. WCT (full covariance) may transfer DINOv2-sensitive stats more precisely while preserving spatial structure (whitening preserves normalized structure).

BOTTLENECK ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED: DINOv2 CLS token dual-sensitivity to style AND content. Evidence: (1) All 35+ training directions that inject more style increase CLIP-S but DECREASE DINO-S — content degradation cancels style gain. (2) AdaIN sweep shows inference params have ±0.002 effect on DINO-S before cliff. (3) Phase-anchored proved frequency-domain operations irrelevant. (4) WCT (full covariance) is WORSE than AdaIN (diagonal) in latent space. CONCLUSION: DINO-S 0.48 ceiling is a STRUCTURAL constraint of DINOv2 CLS + SAT training paradigm, not an optimization problem. All directions within Haar DWT + SAT + FM framework exhausted.
